Lemma
[Characterization of canonical form for shrinkers] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0181, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0182 1. ch30:30.29\group Type I Ancient Solutions

Let $(\mathcal M,g(t),f(t),1/t)$, $t<0$, be a complete bounded-curvature shrinking gradient Ricci soliton. It is in canonical form, \[ g(t)=-t\, \varphi (t)^*g(-1),\qquad f(t)=f(-1)\circ \varphi (t), \] if and only if $\partial _t f=|\nabla f|^2$.
